source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Ethical Use of Technology under 9.5 as printed (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Ethical use of technology involves acting responsibly and avoiding harm through digital actions. This includes respecting privacy, fairness, and proper handling of information. Following ethical guidelines helps maintain trust and safety online. Decisions in technology should consider the potential effects on people, organizations, and society. Responsible use of digital tools supports a safe and fair digital environment.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Copying online content without permission can violate both copyright laws and digital ethics
